## Review Summary

This PR corrects a configuration gap in the Opencode agent variants: the three auditor sub-agents and three researcher sub-agents were missing `"echo*": "allow"` in their bash permission blocks and `"chroma/*": true` in their `tools:` blocks. Both entries are present in the parent `auditor.md` and `researcher.md` files and were previously an oversight in the derived variants. The changes are frontmatter-only — no body text was modified. The fix is straightforward and correctly propagates the additions to all six affected files in lockstep.

**Files Reviewed:** 6  
**Findings:** 0 Critical, 0 Warning, 3 Suggestion

### Suggestions

```
[S-01] Tool ordering in auditor variants diverges from parent
Category: Style
Severity: Suggestion
File: .opencode/agents/auditor-kimi.md, auditor-qwen.md, auditor-glm.md
Lines: tools: block
Description: The parent `auditor.md` declares tools in the order: chroma/*, context7/*, tavily/*.
The auditor variants after this PR declare them in the order: chroma/*, tavily/*, context7/*.
YAML maps are unordered and runtime behavior is identical, but visual divergence makes future
sync reviews harder to validate at a glance.
Suggestion: Reorder to match the parent: chroma/*, context7/*, tavily/* — or standardise
the parent to match the variants. Either direction is acceptable.
```

```
[S-02] Pre-existing: opencode-runtime.md line 197 claims researcher family has the "only"
developer-local MCP dependency — already false before this PR
Category: Documentation
Severity: Suggestion
File: docs/features/opencode-runtime.md
Lines: 197
Description: The sentence reads: "The researcher family still has the only developer-local
MCP dependency in the agent inventory." However, the auditor variants (auditor-kimi.md,
auditor-qwen.md, auditor-glm.md) already declare `io.github.tavily-ai/tavily-mcp/*` and
`io.github.upstash/context7/*` — the same developer-local tools — prior to this PR. The
statement was already inaccurate when the auditor variants received those tools in an earlier
commit; this PR does not introduce or worsen the inaccuracy.
Suggestion: Update the sentence to acknowledge that both researcher and auditor families
carry developer-local MCP dependencies (Tavily, Context7).
```

```
[S-03] Pre-existing: auditor-glm.md sync note has malformed closing bold marker
Category: Documentation
Severity: Suggestion
File: .opencode/agents/auditor-glm.md
Lines: body text, sync note paragraph
Description: The sync note reads: "...must be applied to all three files in lockstep`."
The closing marker is a lone backtick (`) rather than the closing bold `**` that opens the
phrase. This produces a dangling inline-code fragment in rendered Markdown. Not introduced

Suggestion: Change `lockstep`` to `lockstep**` to close the bold span correctly:
  "Any change to this body text **must be applied to all three files in lockstep**."
```

## Overall Assessment

The changes are correct and complete. All six agent variants that were missing `echo*` and `chroma/*` have been updated in lockstep, matching the parent `auditor.md` and `researcher.md` files. The dual-run policy (Opencode ↔ Copilot) does not apply here because the changed fields (`tools:` and `permission.bash`) are Opencode-specific frontmatter with no equivalent structure in the Copilot `.agent.md` format. No behavioral regressions, security issues, or correctness defects were identified. The PR is ready to merge. The three suggestions are all pre-existing issues or a minor style inconsistency with no runtime impact.
